title: An introduction to legendplot
text: legendplot provides tools combine standard R plots, rgl 3D plots, legend representing either continuous color scale categorical (factor) legend. basic graphics device provides legend() function adding legends, problem can obscure main plot; furthermore, suitable categorical values useful adding continuous color scale. rgl package offers legend3d(), incorporates standard legend bitmap background current RGL subscene. legendplot (currently) provides following main functions: continuous legend: splot(), spoints(), simage(), spersp(). categorical legend: fplot() fpoints(). continuous legend: splot3d(), spoints3d(), spersp3d() sshade3d(). categorical legend: fplot3d(), fpoints3d() fshade3d(). continuous legends: scolor(), jet.colors()hot.colors() categorical legends: fcolor(), hcld.colors() cat.colors(). rgl tools: new3d(), viewpoint (e.g. setviewpoint3d()) mouse actions (e.g. setmouse3d()) utilities. packages may interest : plot3D: Plotting Multi-Dimensional Data. ggplot2: Create Elegant Data Visualisations Using Grammar Graphics. plotly: Create Interactive Web Graphics via plotly.js. Nevertheless, prefer standard rgl graphics, mainly render faster dealing large amounts data (also following “keep small simple”, KISS, principle).
code: library(legendplot) ## legendplot: Standard and 'rgl' Plots with Legends, ##   version 0.4-0 (built on 2026-09-08). ##   Copyright (C) R. Fernandez-Casal 2012-2026. ##   Type `vignette("legendplot", package = "legendplot")` ##   or visit https://rubenfcasal.github.io/legendplot ##   for an overview.

title: An introduction to legendplot
text: base function continuous legend splot(). splits plotting region main panel legend strip showing continuous color scale (based fields::image.plot()). calling function, main graph can draw usual. example:  scolor() maps numeric vector colors continuous palette, : jet.colors(): rainbow-style palette (similar MATLAB jet). hot.colors(): useful values ranging zero maximum (e.g. densities). splot() can also used add = TRUE attach legend existing plot. instance, several plots can share common color scale:  package also supplies high-level functions make pattern automatic. sxxxx() family functions (spoints(), simage() spersp()) draws color-scale legend corresponding base plot (plot(), image() persp()), appropriate colors, single call:  functions “compatible” mfcol mfrow graphics parameters:  share legend-related arguments splot(), accept legend = FALSE draw main plot without legend. default, plot parameters reset values entering function. reset = FALSE reset make possible add features plot (e.g. using functions points lines).
code: scale.range <- range(mtcars$mpg) res <- splot(slim = scale.range, legend.lab = "mpg") with(mtcars,       plot(hp, qsec, col = scolor(mpg, slim = scale.range),           pch = 16, cex = 1.5, main = "Motor Trend Car Road Tests") ) par(res$old.par) # restore graphical parameters set.seed(1) nx <- c(40, 40) x1 <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = nx[1]) x2 <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = nx[2]) trend <- outer(x1, x2, function(x, y) x^2 - y^2) y <- trend + rnorm(prod(nx), 0, 0.1)  scale.range <- c(-1.2, 1.2) scale.color <- jet.colors(256)  old.par <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), omd = c(0.05, 0.85, 0.05, 0.95)) image(x1, x2, trend, zlim = scale.range, main = "Trend", col = scale.color) image(x1, x2, y, zlim = scale.range, main = "Data", col = scale.color) par(old.par) splot(slim = scale.range, col = scale.color, legend.shrink = 0.7, add = TRUE) with(mtcars,       spoints(hp, qsec, mpg, main = "Motor Trend Car Road Tests",              xlab = "Horsepower", ylab = "1/4 mile time",               legend.lab = "Miles per gallon") ) old.par <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2)) spersp(x1, x2, trend, slim = scale.range, main = "Trend", zlab = "y", legend = FALSE) simage(x1, x2, y, slim = scale.range, main = "Data", legend.mar = 10, legend.width = 3) par(old.par)

title: An introduction to legendplot
text: fplot() categorical counterpart splot(): instead color bar draws classic factor-level legend (boxes, points line segments), using legend() internally.  fcolor() maps factor (vector coercible one) colors, using categorical palette hcld.colors() (based hcl.colors() “Dark 3”) cat.colors() (based ColorBrewer 2.0).
code: f <- as.factor(mtcars$cyl) res <- fplot(levels(f), col = cat.colors(nlevels(f)), type = "point",              legend.lab = "cyl") with(mtcars, plot(hp, qsec, col = fcolor(f, col = res$col),                    pch = 16, cex = 1.5, main = "Motor Trend Car Road Tests")) par(res$old.par)

title: An introduction to legendplot
text: ideas extend interactive 3D scenes built rgl package. splot3d() fplot3d() split active rgl device main subscene legend subscene. calling one functions, usual rgl plotting functions can used normal. example: new3d() serves replacement open3d() clear3d() functions1. opens new device none exists (argument open = TRUE set) , otherwise, clears current one. addition, changes several default mouse actions ‘rgl’, assigning middle button zoom (via setmouse3d()), right button pan (via pan3d()), enabling double-click left button restore scene’s default viewpoint (via dbltrack3d(); keeping mouse acting virtual trackball, rotating scene, button held ). Unfortunately, mouse actions currently work RMarkdown documents. High-level 3D plot functions also available, named form sxxx3d() fxxx3d(), allow corresponding 3D graph plotted along legend, either continuous categorical, single call. example, plot shown generated following command: Similarly, fpoints3d() draws 3D scatter plot categorical legend, spersp3d() draws 3D surface plot continuous color scale, sshade3d() fshade3d() draw colored triangular mesh together continuous categorical legend, respectively. final example, topography Auckland’s Maunga Whau volcano (bundled volcanom mesh) can displayed following code:
code: library(rgl) # Use `open3d()` or `new3d()` to open a new device. scale.range <- range(mtcars$mpg) splot3d(slim = scale.range, legend.lab = "mpg") with(mtcars,       plot3d(hp, qsec, wt, type = "s",             col = scolor(mpg, slim = scale.range)) ) with(mtcars, spoints3d(hp, qsec, wt, s = mpg, type = "s")) sshade3d(volcanom, s = volcanom$vb[3, ], meshColor = "facesvertices")

title: An introduction to legendplot
text: Beyond plotting functions , legendplot also provides usefull tools working rgl plots: vb2tri3d(): computes one value per triangle values given vertices mesh (used sshade3d() meshColor = "facesvertices"). setviewpoint3d(), addviewpoint3d(), getviewpoints3d(), lsviewpoints3d(), rmviewpoints3d(), getview3d() setview3d(): manage (save, list, restore…) named rgl user viewpoints. setmouse3d(), pan3d() dbltrack3d(): configure rgl mouse actions (used internally new3d()). axis3(): draws 3D axis control tick length, tick angle label position (used internally fplot3d()).

title: Utilities for plotting with a continuous color scale — continuous-color
text: scolor converts real valued vector color scale. range slim divided length(col) + 1 pieces equal length. Values fall outside range scale coded NA. jet.colors generates rainbow style color table similar MATLAB (TM) jet color scheme. may appropriate distinguish values central value (e.g. positive negative values). hot.colors generates color table similar MATLAB (TM) hot color scheme (reversed default). may appropriate represent values ranging 0 maximum level (e.g. density estimation). default value rev = TRUE may adequate grayscale conversion.

what: Add a categorical legend to an standard R plot — fplot
title: Add a categorical legend to an standard R plot — fplot
text: fplot() designed combine standard R plot categorical (factor) legend. Analogous splot(), splits plotting region main panel legend panel, uses legend() draw labels colors symbols.

title: Add a categorical legend to an standard R plot — fplot
code: fplot(   labels,   col = hcld.colors(length(labels)),   type = c("box", "point", "line"),   pch = 16,   lty = 1,   lwd = 2,   cex = 1,   border = col,   pt.cex = cex * 1.5,   seg.len = 1.5,   horizontal = FALSE,   legend.shrink = 1,   legend.width = NULL,   legend.mar = NULL,   legend.lab = NULL,   legend.x = "center",   bigplot = NULL,   smallplot = NULL,   add = FALSE,   ... )

title: Add a categorical legend to an standard R plot — fplot
text: labels vector category labels. col colors associated level (order labels). Defaults hcld.colors(). type type symbols shown legend: "box" filled color boxes (classic factor-level legend), "point" points, "line" line segments. pch plotting ‘character’ (symbol) used type = "point". lty, lwd line types widths lines appearing legend, type = "line". cex text/symbol size legend. border, pt.cex, seg.len additional legend() parameters, also used estimate required legend width/height. default values : border = col, pt.cex = cex * 1.5 seg.len = 1.5. horizontal logical; FALSE (default) legend appear right side. TRUE legend along bottom. legend.shrink amount shrink size legend relative full height width plot. legend.width, legend.mar control size margin legend panel, splot(). left NULL (default), computed automatically following character-size logic legend() uses internally. legend.lab legend title. legend.x legend location relative legend panel (argument x legend()). Possible values : "center" (default), "bottomright", "bottom", "bottomleft", "left", "topleft", "top", "topright" "right". bigplot, smallplot plot coordinates main legend panels. passed determined within function. add logical; TRUE legend just added existing plot (graphical parameters changed). ... additional arguments passed legend().

title: Add a categorical legend to an standard R plot — fplot
text: fplot() invisibly returns list components: bigplot, smallplot, old.par, col labels (par(old.par) reset plot parameters values entering function).

title: Utilities for setting the 'rgl' mouse actions — mouse-actions
text: Functions set mouse button actions rgl subscene (current one active device default). setmouse3d() sets 'rgl' built-mouse button modes (via rgl::par3d()). pan3d() configures callback functions mouse button dragging pans subscene (opened) rgl device. dbltrack3d() installs, given mouse button rgl (sub)scene, standard "trackball" rotation behavior (parameter mouseMode rgl::par3d()), extended double-clicking resets viewpoint "default" values.

Use 1 left, 2 right, 3 middle, 4 wheel, 0 set action button pressed. message whether print message confirming configured button, device subscene. max.interval maximum time, seconds, two clicks treated double-click. capture.now logical; FALSE (default) "default" viewpoint restored double-click (see setviewpoint3d()). title: Add a continuous color scale legend to an standard R plot — splot
text: slim limits used set color scale. col color table used set color scale (see image details). breaks (optional) numeric vector breakpoints color scale: must one breakpoint col increasing order. horizontal logical; FALSE (default) legend appear right side. TRUE legend along bottom. legend.shrink amount shrink size legend relative full height width plot. legend.width width characters legend strip. Default 1.2, little bigger width character. legend.mar width characters legend margin axis. Default 5.1 vertical legend 3.1 horizontal legend. legend.lab label axis color legend. Default label usual evident plot title. bigplot plot coordinates main plot. passed determined within function. smallplot plot coordinates legend strip. passed determined within function. lab.breaks breaks supplied text string labels put break value. intended label axis transformed scale logs. axis.args additional arguments axis function used create legend axis (see image.plot details). legend.args arguments complete specification legend label. form list just passed mtext function. Usually needed (see image.plot details). add logical; TRUE legend just added existing plot (graphical parameters changed).

code: # Plot equivalent to spoints(): scale.range <- range(mtcars$mpg) res <- splot(slim = scale.range, legend.lab = "mpg") with(mtcars,    plot(hp, qsec, col = scolor(mpg, slim = scale.range),         pch = 16, cex = 1.5, main = "Motor Trend Car Road Tests") )  par(res$old.par) # restore graphical parameters  # Multiple plots with a common legend: # regularly spaced 2D data... set.seed(1) nx <- c(40, 40) # ndata =  prod(nx) x1 <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = nx[1]) x2 <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = nx[2]) trend <- outer(x1, x2, function(x,y) x^2 - y^2) y <- trend + rnorm(prod(nx), 0, 0.1) scale.range <- c(-1.2, 1.2) scale.color <- jet.colors(256) # 1x2 plot with some room for the legend... old.par <- par(mfrow = c(1,2), omd = c(0.05, 0.85, 0.05, 0.95)) image( x1, x2, trend, zlim = scale.range, main = 'Trend', col = scale.color) image( x1, x2, y, zlim = scale.range, main = 'Data', col = scale.color) par(old.par) # the legend can be added to any plot... splot(slim = scale.range, col = scale.color, legend.shrink = 0.7, add = TRUE)  ## note that argument 'zlim' in 'image' corresponds with 'slim' in 'sxxxx' functions.

what: Draw 3D mesh objects adding a continuous color scale — sshade3d
title: Draw 3D mesh objects adding a continuous color scale — sshade3d
text: Draws triangular mesh (mesh3d) colored according continuous scale associated vector values s (via rgl::shade3d()), (optionally) adds color-bar legend (via splot3d()).

title: Draw 3D mesh objects adding a continuous color scale — sshade3d
code: sshade3d(   x,   s,   meshColor = c("faces", "facesvertices", "vertices"),   slim = range(s, finite = TRUE),   col = jet.colors(128),   legend = TRUE,   legend.zoom = 0.4,   legend.width = 0.1,   legend.dim = 0.2,   legend.lab = NULL,   box = TRUE,   lab.breaks = NULL,   lab.ticksize = 0.5,   lab.dist = 3,   ... )

title: Draw 3D mesh objects adding a continuous color scale — sshade3d
text: x triangular mesh (mesh3d object, see rgl::mesh3d()). s values used color mesh. interpreted depends meshColor. meshColor determines material colours (textures) interpreted: "faces" applies color per face; "facesvertices" assumes s contains one value per vertex, calculates average per face (via vb2tri3d()), applies resulting color face; "vertices" applies color per vertex. See rgl::shade3d(). slim limits (vector length 2 minimum maximum) used set color scale. col color table used set color scale. Defaults jet.colors(128). legend logical; TRUE (default), active rgl device splitted two subscenes, drawing 3D mesh object one legend color scale (see splot3d()). FALSE (coloured) mesh drawn arguments related legend ignored (splot3d() called). legend.zoom zoom factor applied legend subscene (see rgl::view3d()). legend.width relative width color bar, fraction corresponding dimension legend subscene/panel. legend.dim relative dimension legend panel, fraction full width (height) device. legend.lab legend title. box logical; TRUE (default) rectangle drawn around color bar. lab.breaks labels legend axis breaks; NULL generated automatically (see axis3()). lab.ticksize length legend axis tick marks, fraction distance center legend panel. lab.dist distance tick marks labels legend axis, multiple lab.ticksize. ... additional arguments passed rgl::shade3d().

#ifdef GL_ES
#ifdef GL_FRAGMENT_PRECISION_HIGH
precision highp float;
#else
precision mediump float;
#endif
#endif

attribute vec3 aPos;
attribute vec4 aCol;
uniform mat4 mvMatrix;
uniform mat4 prMatrix;
varying vec4 vCol;
varying vec4 vPosition;

#ifdef NEEDS_VNORMAL
attribute vec3 aNorm;
uniform mat4 normMatrix;
varying vec4 vNormal;
#endif

#if defined(HAS_TEXTURE) || defined (IS_TEXT)
attribute vec2 aTexcoord;
varying vec2 vTexcoord;
#endif

#ifdef FIXED_SIZE
uniform vec3 textScale;
#endif

#ifdef FIXED_QUADS
attribute vec3 aOfs;
#endif

#ifdef IS_TWOSIDED
#ifdef HAS_NORMALS
varying float normz;
uniform mat4 invPrMatrix;
#else
attribute vec3 aPos1;
attribute vec3 aPos2;
varying float normz;
#endif
#endif // IS_TWOSIDED

#ifdef FAT_LINES
attribute vec3 aNext;
attribute vec2 aPoint;
varying vec2 vPoint;
varying float vLength;
uniform float uAspect;
uniform float uLwd;
#endif

#ifdef USE_ENVMAP
varying vec3 vReflection;
#endif

void main(void) {
  
#ifndef IS_BRUSH
#if defined(NCLIPPLANES) || !defined(FIXED_QUADS) || defined(HAS_FOG) || defined(USE_ENVMAP)
  vPosition = mvMatrix * vec4(aPos, 1.);
#endif
  
#ifndef FIXED_QUADS
  gl_Position = prMatrix * vPosition;
#endif
#endif // !IS_BRUSH
  
#ifdef IS_POINTS
  gl_PointSize = POINTSIZE;
#endif
  
  vCol = aCol;
  
// USE_ENVMAP implies NEEDS_VNORMAL

#ifdef NEEDS_VNORMAL
  vNormal = normMatrix * vec4(-aNorm, dot(aNorm, aPos));
#endif

#ifdef USE_ENVMAP
  vReflection = normalize(reflect(vPosition.xyz/vPosition.w, 
                        normalize(vNormal.xyz/vNormal.w)));
#endif
  
#ifdef IS_TWOSIDED
#ifdef HAS_NORMALS
  /* normz should be calculated *after* projection */
  normz = (invPrMatrix*vNormal).z;
#else
  vec4 pos1 = prMatrix*(mvMatrix*vec4(aPos1, 1.));
  pos1 = pos1/pos1.w - gl_Position/gl_Position.w;

  normz = pos1.x*pos2.y - pos1.y*pos2.x;

#endif // IS_TWOSIDED
  
#ifdef NEEDS_VNORMAL
  vNormal = vec4(normalize(vNormal.xyz), 1);
#endif
  
#if defined(HAS_TEXTURE) || defined(IS_TEXT)
  vTexcoord = aTexcoord;
#endif

  vec4 pos = prMatrix * mvMatrix * vec4(aPos, 1.);

  vLength = vLength/(vLength + len);
  if (vLength > 0.0) {

  normal.x /= uAspect;
  vec4 offset = vec4(len*(normal*aPoint.x*aPoint.y - dir), 0.0, 0.0);

  gl_Position = vec4(aPos, 1.);

#ifdef GL_ES
#ifdef GL_FRAGMENT_PRECISION_HIGH
precision highp float;
#else
precision mediump float;
#endif
#endif
varying vec4 vCol; // carries alpha
varying vec4 vPosition;
#if defined(HAS_TEXTURE) || defined (IS_TEXT)
varying vec2 vTexcoord;
uniform sampler2D uSampler;
#endif

#ifdef HAS_FOG
uniform int uFogMode;
uniform vec3 uFogColor;
uniform vec4 uFogParms;
#endif

#if defined(IS_LIT) && !defined(FIXED_QUADS)
varying vec4 vNormal;
#endif

uniform vec4 vClipplane[NCLIPPLANES];
#endif

uniform mat4 mvMatrix;
#endif

uniform vec3 emission;
uniform float shininess;
#if NLIGHTS > 0
uniform vec3 ambient[NLIGHTS];
uniform vec3 specular[NLIGHTS]; // light*material
uniform vec3 diffuse[NLIGHTS];
uniform vec3 lightDir[NLIGHTS];
uniform bool viewpoint[NLIGHTS];
uniform bool finite[NLIGHTS];
#endif
#endif // IS_LIT

#ifdef IS_TWOSIDED
uniform bool front;
varying float normz;
#endif

#ifdef FAT_LINES
varying vec2 vPoint;
varying float vLength;
#endif

#ifdef USE_ENVMAP
varying vec3 vReflection;
#endif

void main(void) {
  vec4 fragColor;
#ifdef FAT_LINES
  vec2 point = vPoint;
  bool neg = point.y < 0.0;
  point.y = neg ? (point.y + vLength)/(1.0 - vLength) :
                 -(point.y - vLength)/(1.0 - vLength);
#if defined(IS_TRANSPARENT) && defined(IS_LINESTRIP)
  if (neg && length(point) <= 1.0) discard;
#endif
  point.y = min(point.y, 0.0);
  if (length(point) > 1.0) discard;
#endif // FAT_LINES
  
#ifdef ROUND_POINTS
  vec2 coord = gl_PointCoord - vec2(0.5);
  if (length(coord) > 0.5) discard;
#endif
  
#if NCLIPPLANES > 0
  for (int i = 0; i < NCLIPPLANES; i++)
    if (dot(vPosition, vClipplane[i]) < 0.0) discard;
#endif
    
#ifdef FIXED_QUADS
    vec3 n = vec3(0., 0., 1.);
#elif defined(IS_LIT)
    vec3 n = normalize(vNormal.xyz);
#endif
    
#ifdef IS_TWOSIDED
    if ((normz <= 0.) != front) discard;
#endif

#ifdef IS_LIT
    vec3 eye = normalize(-vPosition.xyz/vPosition.w);
    vec3 lightdir;
    vec4 colDiff;
    vec3 halfVec;
    vec4 lighteffect = vec4(emission, 0.);
    vec3 col;
    float nDotL;
#ifdef FIXED_QUADS
    n = -faceforward(n, n, eye);
#endif
    
#if NLIGHTS > 0
    // Simulate two-sided lighting
    if (n.z < 0.0)
      n = -n;
    for (int i=0;i<NLIGHTS;i++) {
      colDiff = vec4(vCol.rgb * diffuse[i], vCol.a);
      lightdir = lightDir[i];
      if (!viewpoint[i]) {
        if (finite[i]) {
          lightdir = (mvMatrix * vec4(lightdir, 1.)).xyz;
        } else {
          lightdir = (mvMatrix * vec4(lightdir, 0.)).xyz;
        }

        halfVec = normalize(lightdir + eye);
      } else {
        lightdir = normalize(lightdir - vPosition.xyz/vPosition.w);
        halfVec = normalize(lightdir + eye);

      col = ambient[i];
      nDotL = dot(n, lightdir);
      col = col + max(nDotL, 0.) * colDiff.rgb;

#endif

#endif

    vec4 textureColor = lighteffect*texture2D(uSampler, vTexcoord);

// These calculations use the definitions from

#endif

#if defined(TEXMODE_replace) || defined(TEXMODE_decal)
    textureColor = vec4(textureColor.rgb, lighteffect.a);

    textureColor = lighteffect*vec4(textureColor.rgb, 1.);

    textureColor = vec4((1. - textureColor.rgb) * lighteffect.rgb, lighteffect.a);

    textureColor = vec4(lighteffect.rgb + textureColor.rgb, lighteffect.a);
#endif

#endif

#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_decal

#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_blend
    textureColor = vec4((1. - textureColor.rgb) * lighteffect.rgb,
                    lighteffect.a*textureColor.a);
#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_add
    textureColor = vec4(lighteffect.rgb + textureColor.rgb,
                    lighteffect.a*textureColor.a);
#endif
    
#endif //TEXTURE_rgba

    float luminance = dot(vec3(1.,1.,1.),textureColor.rgb)/3.;

    textureColor = vec4(lighteffect.rgb, luminance);
#endif 

#if defined(TEXMODE_modulate) || defined(TEXMODE_blend) || defined(TEXMODE_add)
    textureColor = vec4(lighteffect.rgb, lighteffect.a*luminance);
#endif
 
#endif // TEXTURE_alpha
    
// The TEXTURE_luminance values are not from that reference    
#ifdef TEXTURE_luminance
    float luminance = dot(vec3(1.,1.,1.),textureColor.rgb)/3.;

#if defined(TEXMODE_replace) || defined(TEXMODE_decal)
    textureColor = vec4(luminance, luminance, luminance, lighteffect.a);
#endif 

#ifdef TEXMODE_modulate
    textureColor = vec4(luminance*lighteffect.rgb, lighteffect.a);
#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_blend
    textureColor = vec4((1. - luminance)*lighteffect.rgb,
                        lighteffect.a);
#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_add
    textureColor = vec4(luminance + lighteffect.rgb, lighteffect.a);
#endif

#endif // TEXTURE_luminance
 
    
#ifdef TEXTURE_luminance_alpha
    float luminance = dot(vec3(1.,1.,1.),textureColor.rgb)/3.;

#if defined(TEXMODE_replace) || defined(TEXMODE_decal)
    textureColor = vec4(luminance, luminance, luminance, textureColor.a);
#endif 

#ifdef TEXMODE_modulate
    textureColor = vec4(luminance*lighteffect.rgb, 
                        textureColor.a*lighteffect.a);
#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_blend
    textureColor = vec4((1. - luminance)*lighteffect.rgb,
                        textureColor.a*lighteffect.a);
#endif

#ifdef TEXMODE_add
    textureColor = vec4(luminance + lighteffect.rgb, 
                        textureColor.a*lighteffect.a);

#endif

#endif // TEXTURE_luminance_alpha
    
    fragColor = textureColor;

#elif defined(IS_TEXT)
    if (textureColor.a < 0.1)
      discard;
    else
      fragColor = textureColor;
#else
    fragColor = lighteffect;
#endif // HAS_TEXTURE

    // fogF will be the proportion of fog
    // Initialize it to the linear value

      fogF = fogF*uFogParms.z;
      if (uFogMode == 2)
        fogF = 1.0 - exp(-fogF);

      // https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/blob/master/src/mesa/swrast/s_fog.c#L58
      else if (uFogMode == 3)
        fogF = 1.0 - exp(-fogF*fogF);
      fogF = clamp(fogF, 0.0, 1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(fragColor.rgb, uFogColor, fogF), fragColor.a);
    } else gl_FragColor = fragColor;
#else
    gl_FragColor = fragColor;
#endif // HAS_FOG

text: addviewpoint3d() called side effect storing view name; invisibly returns view. setviewpoint3d() called side effect restoring stored viewpoint current rgl subscene; invisibly returns corresponding view. lsviewpoints3d() returns character vector names stored viewpoints. rmviewpoints3d() called side effect removing one stored viewpoints. getviewpoints3d() returns named list stored viewpoints. getview3d() returns list components zoom, userMatrix userProjection (see rgl::par3d()). setview3d() called mainly side effect setting viewpoint current rgl subscene (see rgl::par3d()); returns value returned par3d().

title: Work with 'rgl' viewpoints — viewpoints
text: addviewpoint3d() stores view name, silently overwriting viewpoint previously stored name. default view current viewpoint, returned getview3d(). setviewpoint3d() looks viewpoint stored name applies current rgl subscene via setview3d(). lsviewpoints3d() returns names viewpoints currently stored. rmviewpoints3d() Deletes one saved viewpoints name. called without arguments, deletes , always retaining "default" viewpoint. getviewpoints3d() returns named list viewpoints currently stored, one entry per name. getview3d() retrieves parameters define current viewpoint current rgl subscene (zoom, user matrix user projection), can saved restored later setview3d(). setview3d() applies current rgl subscene viewpoint previously obtained getview3d() (also setviewpoint3d() uses internally restore stored viewpoint).

title: legendplot 0.4-0 (2026-09-08)
text: Added spersp3d() S3 generic function (default method), drawing 3D surface (rgl::persp3d()) color-bar legend (calling splot3d()). Renamed legend.mar legend.dim splot3d(), fplot3d(), spoints3d(), spersp3d(), fpoints3d(), sshade3d() fshade3d() (relative dimension legend subscene/panel). Updated legendplot vignette.

title: legendplot 0.3-1 (2026-08-08)
text: Fixed bug fplot(): estimated legend width (height, horizontal = TRUE) now capped half available plotting region, avoiding invalid (non-increasing) bigplot values. Fixed bug causing splot()/fplot() reset R’s internal multi-panel figure counter (e.g. breaking par(mfrow = ...) layouts). Fixed bug fpoints.default(), default legend.lab captures original expression actual f argument. Updated legendplot vignette.

title: legendplot 0.3-0 (2026-08-04)
text: Added type argument fplot3d(), matching legend.type argument fpoints3d() fshade3d(), choose symbol used represent level legend. Argument add sshade3d() fshade3d() renamed legend, consistency. Renamed vb2tri() vb2tri3d(), consistency naming rgl-specific functions. setmousemode() renamed setmouse3d(), added dev subscene arguments, target specific device/subscene. Viewpoint utilities (e.g. setviewpoint()) renamed form xxx3d(). getview3d()/setview3d() now also save/restore field view (FOV). new3d() now also calls dbltrack3d(1), left button rotates usual double-clicking resets view, addition previously configured zoom (middle button/wheel) panning (right button). also automatically stores "default" viewpoint. Legend titles (legend.lab) splot3d()/fplot3d() now placed rgl::mtext3d() instead manually positioned rgl::text3d(). hcld.colors() cat.colors() now also accept, n, vector coercible factor (case nlevels(.factor(n)) colors returned), addition plain integer.

title: legendplot 0.2.1 (2026-07-31)
text: Added dbltrack3d(), reimplements standard trackball rotation given mouse button rgl (sub)scene, extended double-clicking resets viewpoint default values. new3d() now also calls dbltrack3d(1), left button rotates usual double-clicking resets view, addition previously configured zoom (middle button/wheel) panning (right button). Changes splot3d() fplot3d(). main legend subscenes now get independent copy mouse controls (longer affect ). Mouse rotation disabled legend subscene. main plot subscene, since rgl::layout3d(..., mouseMode = "replace") copy user’s mouse handlers (therefore disabled), first one () set trackball double click reset view (via dbltrack3d()), second one panning (via pan3d()). Roxygen2 documentation converted Rd/LaTeX macros (\code{}, \link{}, \item{}{}, …) markdown (`code`, [fn()], bullet lists, …) older functions. Updated legendplot vignette.

title: legendplot 0.2.0 (2026-07-30)
text: Added fpoints() S3 generic function (default method): categorical counterpart spoints(), drawing scatter plot points colored according factor categorical legend (calls fplot()). Added spoints3d() fpoints3d() S3 generic functions (default methods), drawing 3D scatter plot (rgl::plot3d()) together continuous categorical legend, respectively (calls splot3d()/fplot3d()). Added tickangle parameter axis3(), control direction (degrees) tick marks labels offset axis line. Added legendplot vignette.

title: legendplot 0.1.1 (2026-07-28)
text: Added new tools categorical legends standard plots: Added fplot(), categorical counterpart splot(): adds classic factor-level legend (boxes, points line segments) existing new plot. Added fcolor(), hcld.colors() cat.colors(), mapping factor (vector coercible one) categorical color palette. Added new tools rgl (3D) plots legends: Added splot3d() fplot3d(), splitting active rgl device main subscene legend subscene , respectively, continuous color scale categorical legend. Added axis3(), modification rgl::axis3d() independent control tick mark length label position. Added sshade3d() fshade3d(), drawing mesh3d object colored continuous categorical variable, together corresponding legend. Added vb2tri(), computes values per triangle values given vertices mesh (used sshade3d() meshColor = "facesvertices"). Added new3d(), may used replacement open3d() clear3d() functions. Added setmousemode() pan3d() utilities setting ‘rgl’ mouse actions. Added functions retrieve, save, restore, list remove ‘rgl’ viewpoints: set.viewpoint(), get.viewpoints(), add.viewpoint(), ls.viewpoints(), rm.viewpoints(), getview3d() setview3d(). Added volcanom dataset (mesh3d version R’s volcano data, Auckland’s Maunga Whau volcano), used sshade3d()/fshade3d() examples. Added package website (pkgdown).

title: legendplot 0.1.0 (2026-07-01)
text: Initial version, adapting color-scale legend utilities package npsp (Fernandez-Casal, 2018, https://rubenfcasal.github.io/npsp) standalone package: Added splot(), adding continuous color-scale legend (based fields::image.plot()) existing new plot. Added spoints(), simage() spersp() S3 generic functions (default methods), drawing, respectively, scatter plot, image perspective plot together color-scale legend. Added scolor(), jet.colors() hot.colors(), mapping numeric vector continuous color palette.
